book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Mpangu wa kunkoma Yesu
Yesu paakajomwi kulonge mambu ghanihagha ghokapi, akabapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki,
“Mmanyi kubha machobha ghabheli ghaghahika kwibya na Uwangalalu wa Pasaka, na Mwana waka Mundu anaabhohakikaje nahuli awambakikaje punsalaba.”
Chikahi hechi bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, bhalemba, na bhazee bha bhandu, bhakalibhongini paliwangala laka mpenganyambiku nkolongwa, lihina laki Kayafa.
Bhakajetanganili papamu ntundu wa kunkamula Yesu kwa kulihiya, na bhunkomaje.
Nambu bhakapwaghiki, “Ngaikubha chikahi cha uwangalalu la pasaka, ngakwihika kupitalila fujo pachilanda ja bhandu.”
Yesu apakakika mahuta ku Besania
Chikahi Yesu paakabhi ku Besania, kunyumba jaka Simoni joakabhi na chitamu cha malohi,
akahikiki mbomba jumu akabya anyamwi libotolu lelalenganakiki kwa liganga la alabasta lelibhi na mahuta gha mbija jamaheli, na kughajitila pamutu jaka Yesu koni akabya atami pa chilebhe.
Bhabhulwa bhaka Yesu pabhaweni, bhakahakalili na kupwagha, “Bho, maghambu kiki kuhobheha manungilu aghagha waka?”
“Manungilu aghagha ghakabya ghalombasiki kwa mbija jamaheli, na kubhapekeha bhahochu mbija yene!”
Yesu akamanyi maholalelu ghabhu, akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mbona mung'aha mbomba ajoju? Anihengi lijambu lamboni namaa.
Kwa ndandi bhahochu mbi nabhu papamu machobha ghokapi, nambu nepanu ngangubhi papamu na mwehapa machobha ghokapi.
Kwa ndandi kwa kunyitalila hyegha jangu mahuta ghaghanungi wichu aghagha, ahengiki bhenibhela kwa kujilenganakela yegha jangu kwa kutaghakika kwangu.
Numpwaghi chakaka, pandu pokapi Malobhi Manyahi paghitangazwaje pundema wokapi, lihengu aleli leahengiki mbomba ajoju anabhaliloghulaje kwa kunkomboka jombi.”
Yuda ajetakela kung'anambuka Yesu
Bhela Yuda Isikalioti, jumu wa bhabhulwa komi na bhabheli bhala, akapiti kwa bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa,
na kupwagha, “Bho, anambekya chindu bhole, ngati ananumpeki Yesu kwinu?” Bhakambalangili ipandi selasini ya madini gha feza.
Kutumbu chikahi chenihechi, Yuda akabhi alonda mbekenyu ja kung'anambuka Yesu.
Yesu akula chilebhi cha Pasaka papamu na bhabhulwa bhaki
Lichobha la kutumbula la Uwangalalu wa Mabumunda Gangakujegaleka Amila, bhabhulwa bhakapiti kwaka Yesu na kundalukila, “Bho, upala tukakuandalya kwaku chilebhi cha Pasaka?”
Yesu akayangiki, “Njendanya kumbwane kwaka mundu jumu, mukumpwaghilaje, ‘Mbola apwagha, chikahi changu chiheghalile, anangula Pasaka kwaku papamu na bhabhulwa bhangu kunyumba jako.’ ”
Bhabhulwa bhakahengiki ngati Yesu moakabhalagalakile, bhakaandi chilebhi cha Pasaka.
Pakukabhi pakamihi, Yesu akatami kula chilebhi papamu na bhabhulwa bhaki komi na bhabheli bhala.
Pabakabhi bhakula, Yesu akapwaghite, “Numpwaghi chakaka, jumu winu anaaning'anambukaje.”
Bhabhulwa bhala ukabhakabiniki ntima namaa, na bhakatumbwi kundalukila jumu jumu, “Bambo, bho, nepani lelo?”
Yesu akayangiki, “Jola joatobhalile libumunda papamu na nepani mu chikombe, jonihoju nde joaning'anambukaje.
Mwana waka Mundu ajenda ngati moilembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu, nambu anaachibhonaje mundu jola joang'anambuka Mwana waka Mundu! Ikabya mbanga kwaka mundu hoju ngati ngaakabhelakike.”
Yuda, jola joang'anambwiki, akundalukile, “Mbola, bho, nepani lelo?” Yesu akayangiki, “Wehapa ujomwi kupwagha.”
Kutumbula kwa chilebhi chaka Bambo
Pabhakabhi bhakula, Yesu akatoliki libumunda, akalipengalili, akalihekiki, na kubhapekeha bhabhulwa bhaki, akapwagha, “Mtolaje, mkulaje, jenjenu nde hyegha jangu.”
Akachitoliki chikombi, akunchengwi Chapanga, na kubhapekeha, akapwagha, “Mkunywaje mabhokapi mu chikombi chenjenu,
kwa ndandi ghongoni nde mwahi wangu wa Lulaghilu lwa chakaka, mwahi ghoujitika kwa ndandi ja kubhoha mahoku gha bhandu bhamaheli.
Nambu numpwaghila, ngangunywi kabheti divai ja zabibu, mbaka lichobha lela panikunywa divai jahenu papamu na mwehapa mu Ukolongwa wa Atati wangu.”
Pabhakajomwi kujemba nyembu ja kundumbali Chapanga, bhakapitiki kunja na kujenda ku Chitombi cha Mizeituni.
Yesu andotela Petulu anaankanaje
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Lalenu ikilu mwehapa mabhokapi anamndilaje, kwa ndandi Malembu Mahuhu ghapwagha,

content.text: na mambeleli gha lipogha ghitenda kupechangana.’
Nambu ananyomwi kuhyoka, ananundongulya kujenda ku Galilaya.”

content: Petulu akayangiki, “Hata ngati bhokapi anabhakulekiki, nepanu nganakuleki ng'o.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Nukupwaghi chakaka, wehapa, ikilu ja lalenu mangani ja kubheka likongobhe, wingana mala patatu.”
Petulu akayangiki, “Hata ngati imbalika kupotela papamu na wehapa, nganakuleki ng'o.” Na bhabhulwa bhokapi bhakapwaghiki bhelabhela.
Yesu andobha Chapanga ku Gethemane
Bhela Yesu akapiti papamu na bhabhulwa bhaki mbaka pandu papalowakeka Gethemane, na kubhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki, “Mtamanya pambane, nepanu nyenda palongi nakanopi kundobha Chapanga.”
Akuntoliki Petulu papamu na bhana bhabheli bhaka Zebedayo, na akatumbwi kubha na mabhinilu na kungajika.
Panihapa akabhapwaghile, “Mi na mabhinilu makolongwa muntima jangu hata pambipi kupotela. Ntamanya pambani na mkeshaje papamu na nepani.”

Bhela akajendali palongi pachokopi, akaabwiki ukutama, na kundobha Chapanga, akapwagha, “Atati wangu, ngati anaiwezikana, chikombi chenjenu cha mang'ahiku chimbetaje. Nambu ngakwikubha ngati mombalila nepanu, nambu ngati moupali wehapa.”
Akakelawiki kwa bhabhulwa bhala, na kubhahimani bhaghochile. Akumpwaghi Petulu, “Bho, ngachemwaweziki kutama mihu na nepanu hata lisaa limu?
Mtama mihu, na mlobhaje ngamwihika kujingi mu malengakeku. Roho jipala nambu hyegha ngachejibhi na makili.”
Yesu akapiti kabheti pakabheli kundobha Chapanga, “Atati wangu, anangati ngacheiwezikana chikombi achechi cha mang'ahiku chimbetaje pangakunywelela, mapalu ghaku ghapitalyaje.”
Akakelabwiki kabheti, na kubhahimani bhaghochile, kwa ndandi mihu ghabhu ghakatweli lughono.
Akabhalekiki kabheti, na kujenda kundobha Chapanga pakatatu, koni akapwagha malobhi ghalaghala.

Bhela akakelabwiki kabheti kwa bhabhulwa bhaki, na kubhapwaghila, “Bho, mwakali kughochela na kupomulela? Mlingalya, chikahi chihikite, na Mwana waka Mundu anaajeghalika mu mabhoku gha bhabhabhi na mahoku.
Njumukaje, na tumbokanyaje. Ndingalya, jola joaying'anambukaje ahika!”
Yesu akamulika

Bhela, Yesu paakabhi akali kulongela nabhu, palapala akahikiki Yuda, jumu wa bhabhulwa komi na bhabheli bhala. Papamu naku lakabhi lipogha likolongwa bhanyamwi mapanga na indonga, bhakabya bhahumiki kwa bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhazee bha bhandu.
Jola joapalika kung'anambuka Yesu jola akajomwi kubhapekeha nginyulila kubha, “Jola jonambuswaje, jonihoju nde jombi, munkamulaje!”
Bhela, Yuda akamuheghali Yesu, na kupwagha, “Monile, Mbola!” Na kumbusu.
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Nkoche, uhenga lela leuhiki kulihenga.” Panihapa bhandu bhala bhakapiti, na kuhatambula mabhoku ghabhu, na kunkamula na kunkonga.
Lingalya, jumu wa bhala bhabhakabhi papamu na Yesu akaholapwi lipanga laki, na kundapula mtumika waka Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa, na kuncheku likutu.
Panihapa Yesu akumpwaghile, “Ukelabhuha lipanga laku pandu paki. Kwa ndandi jokapi joatumi lipanga, anaapotila kwa lipanga.
Bho, uholake kubha nepanu ngachenhweza kundobha Atati wangu, najombi akabya anetile sajenu manjolinjoli mapogha komi na ghabheli nakanopi gha bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga?
Nambu ngati ananhengiki bhenibhela, bho, anaghapitalya bhole Malembu Mahuhu ghala ghaghapwagha kubha ipalika mambu aghagha ghapitalyaje?”

Chikahi hechi Yesu akabhapwaghi lipogha la bhandu bhabhakahikiki kunkamula, “Bho, muhikiki kungamula kwa mapanga na indonga ngati nepani nde mnyaghula? Machobha ghokapi ndamika mu liwangala la Nyumba jaka Chapanga koni nakabholaje, na ngachemwangamwile.
Nambu mambu aghagha ghokapi ghahengakiki, nahuli Malembu Mahuhu gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga ghapitalyaje.” Panihapa bhabhulwa bhokapi bhakundekiki, na kutila.
Yesu palongi ja pachengu
Bhela, bhabhunkamwi Yesu bhakumpeliki kunyumba jaka Kayafa, joakabhi Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa, kobhakabhii bhalibhongini bhalemba na bhazee bha bhandu.
Nambu Petulu akunjengalili cha kutali mbaka pa liwangala laka Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa, akajingi mkati, na kutama papamu na bhalonda, nahuli alola mambu moghijomukyaje.
Bhela, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, papamu na chengu chokapi, bhakalondiki ulandilu wa icholi panani jaka Yesu, nahuli bhapata kunkoma,
nambu ngachebhakuweni ulandilu wokapi, hata koni bhakahikiki bhalandilu bhamaheli bha icholi. Pakujomukela bhakahikiki bhalandila bhabheli,
na kupwagha, “Mundu ajoju akapwaghiki, ‘Nhweza kujibombo Nyumba jaka Chapanga, na kujichenga kabheti kwa machobha ghatatu.’ ”
Henu Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa akajemiki, na kundaluki Yesu, “Bho, ngacheuyanga lilobhi? Bho, bhandu abhabha bhukutaki kyani panani jaku?”
Nambu Yesu akatumbi chinunu. Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa akumpwaghile, “Nukulapisha kwaka Chapanga joabhi mwome, utupwaghilaje ngati wehapa nde wa Kristo, Mwana waka Chapanga.”

Yesu akumpwaghile, “Wehapa upwaghite. Nambu numpwaghila, kutumbu sajenu anamumbona Mwana waka Mundu atemi ku chiwoku cha kumalelelu chaka Chapanga mwene makili, na akahika panani ja mahundi gha kunani kumahunde.”
Panihapa Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa akakachwili ingobhu yaki, koni akapwagha, “Atehi kutondola! Bho, tupala kabheti ulandilu ghongi wa kyane? Sajenu njowini kutondoka kwaki.
Bho, mwanganya muholale bhole?” Bhombi bhakayangiki, “Impalika kupotela.”
Panihapa bhakamuhuni imata kumihu, bhakundapwi ngumi, na bhangi bhakumbangwi maghanja,
koni bhakapwaghaje, “We Kristo, ulotilaje, bho, nane joakulapwile?”
Petulu ankana Yesu
Petulu akabhi atemi kunja kuliwangala. Mtumika jumu wa chimbomba akunjendili, na kupwagha, “Wehapa nanau ukabhi papamu na Yesu wa ku Galilaya.”
Petulu akakaniki palongi ja bhandu bhokapi, koni akapwagha, “Ngachenimanyi cheulongela.”
Paakabhi apita pundyangu, mtumika jongi wa chimbomba akumbweni, na akabhapwaghi bhandu bhabhakabhi panihapa, “Mundu ajoju akabhi papamu na Yesu wa ku Nazaleti.”
Petulu akakaniki kabheti kwa kulapa, “Ngachenummanyi mundu ajoju.”
Palongi pachokopi, bhandu bhabhakabhi panipala bhakunjendi Petulu, na kumpwaghila, “Chakaka, wehapa nde jumu wabhu, kwa ndandi hata kulongela kwaku kukulangiha.”
Panihapa Petulu akatumbwi kusola na kulapa, koni akapwagha, “Ngachenummanyi mundu hoju.” Palapala likongobhi likabekite.
Petulu akalikombwiki lilobhi lela leakalongi Yesu, “Mangani ja likongobhi kubheka, wingana mala patatu.” Bhela akapitiki kunja, na kulela kwa mabhinilu.
